name: hstack
description: 97 SSH-first setup and operations skills for Hermes 0.22.5, covering 71 integrations and 8 chat platforms. Source-verified; live vendor validation remains pending.

interface.longDescription: hstack provides 97 agent-readable procedures for installing and operating Hermes 0.22.5 over SSH, including 71 integration procedures, 8 messaging platforms and reviewable blueprints. Procedures document credential preflights, native gateway checks and scoped recovery. Source and isolated regression checks are not live vendor or gateway verification; recovery cannot undo external side effects.
